commits.message: fix(progress): counts are refused at addTask/updateTask when not finite; MofNCompleteColumn takes Rich's separator (rich-progress-adjo)

fix(progress): MofNCompleteColumn pads the count to the total's width, whole and styled, as Rich does (rich-progress-adjo)

Rich 9d8f9a3 draws f"{int(completed):{len(str(total))}d}/{int(total)}" in
progress.download; this drew the raw numbers unpadded and unstyled, so the
column widened as it counted. The ticket's TimeElapsed/TimeRemaining cases
were already fixed by #313 (rich-progress-jj5r) and are pinned there.

fix(progress): ProgressBar draws half cells and no back without colour, as Rich does (rich-progress-mn24) (#331)

* fix(progress): ProgressBar counts half cells and leaves its back blank without colour, as Rich does (rich-progress-mn24)

Rich 9d8f9a3 counts the fill in half cells, drawing ╸ on a half and opening
the back with ╺, and draws the back only when the console has colour. A
total of zero is a full, finished bar there, and now here.

* fix(progress): drop the unused percentComplete, treat width 0 as none, document the colourless bar (rich-progress-mn24)

* fix(progress): a negative bar width draws nothing rather than throwing (rich-progress-mn24)

effects-feel: breaths come in spells and rest after a sigh, wind gathers and slackens, halos never add (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Breath depth follows slow noise over the breaths, and the breath after a
sigh is quieter (x0.8) and late. Drift's advance surges between 0.33x and
1.15x STRIDE on noise over two periods. Overlapping firefly halos take
the brighter, as shimmer's passes do.

Worst 1 fps step over an hour: pulse 0.0395 (unchanged), drift
0.0286 -> 0.0256, sparkle 0.0324 -> 0.0236. A loose answering wave
between fireflies was tried and dropped: it bunched every turn's flashes
into one burst with long dark gaps.

effects-feel: a sigh catches once on the way in and draws in again (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

A swell is now a list of knots joined by raised cosines; breath and
firefly flash keep their shapes, and the sigh gains its double inhale.
Each part of the sigh's inhale climbs less steeply than a breath, so the
1 fps worst step over an hour stays 0.0395. REACH 0.3 -> 0.27 keeps a
whole-element rest between breaths now a sigh lasts 0.70 of its turn.
